title: Table
description: Hairline rules between rows, tabular numerals, emphasis by weight rather than fill

props.name: interactive
props.description: Table: enable row hover/focus styling; defaults to false. Put actual links or buttons in cells for interaction.

props.name: strong
props.description: TableRow only: emphasize a total or other important row; defaults to false.

props.name: numeric
props.description: TableHead and TableCell only: align numeric columns; defaults to false.

props.name: quiet
props.description: TableCell only: apply the quieter text tone; defaults to false.

props.name: scope
props.description: TableHead only: native header association; defaults to col. Other table anatomy exports forward their native element props.
